attchmntText: Ramky Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release
voiceSummary: Ramky Infrastructure Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on 6th November 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at Rs. 604.54 crore, a 28.2% increase from Rs. 471.64 crore in Q2 FY26. Consolidated profit after tax increased by 35.9% to Rs. 102.81 crore from Rs. 75.63 crore. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, consolidated revenue rose 26.4% to Rs. 1,075.77 crore. Consolidated profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 141.61 crore, compared to Rs. 152.66 crore in the previous year. Standalone revenue for Q2 FY27 grew 21.2% to Rs. 538.94 crore. Standalone profit after tax for the quarter was Rs. 75.98 crore. The company reported a diversified order book of over Rs. 12,000 crore.

attchmntText: Ramky Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ramky Infrastructure Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 under regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. Consolidated revenue from operations was 605 crore, up 28% year-on-year. EBITDA was 179 crore with a 30% margin. Profit after tax was 103 crore, up 36% year-on-year. The order book stood at 12,000 crore as of 30 September 2026. Standalone revenue was 539 crore. EBITDA was 123 crore. Profit after tax was 76 crore. The company highlighted execution of the Dighi Port Industrial Area and Godavari Drinking Water Supply Scheme. Net debt to equity ratio was 0.57 times.

attchmntText: The Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on Friday, 06th November, 2026, have inter alia approved the following:1.
